expires_today.title: Gatchaman and Speed Racer by Mad Cave Studios
expires_today.description: Catch up with Speed Racer & friends!
expires_today.long_description: Dive into an all‑new interpretation of Tatsuo Yoshida’s classic manga series, Speed Racer, with our latest comics bundle! Follow the adventures of Speed, Trixie, Pops, Spritle, and Chim Chim as they race to save the day in the iconic symbol of speed and gadgetry—the Mach Five. Discover the high‑speed action of this timeless franchise! And, if that’s not enough adventure for you, we’ve included the iconic Gatchaman series for the ultimate teamup! Both legendary series are in one awesome bundle—plus, your purchase helps support the Make‑A‑Wish Foundation.

expires_today.title: Gear & Glory Action RPGs
expires_today.long_description:
Action RPGs reign supreme within the Gear & Glory Action RPGs Bundle! Text your group chat and party up for Wayfinder, the 3‑player co‑op ARPG where you customize your legendary Wayfinder hero to collect loot and slay enemies. Become the ultimate shapeshifter in Coridden, the ARPG that focuses on deadly hack‑’n’-slash combat and transformational beast powers to defeat foes and uncover tightly guarded secrets. Climb to the top of Tower of Kalemonvo, a hardcore isometric ARPG where customization is king! Collect the gear and claim your glory—plus, your purchase helps support Gold Star Gamers.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 16th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Batman Day Comics Bundle by DC Comics
expires_today.long_description:
Own the night alongside the Caped Crusader with the Batman Day Comics Bundle 2026! Pay what you want for a catalog of modern classics by the biggest Batman artists and writers like Dan Watters, Scott Snyder, and Nick Dragotta. Read the Bat's action‑packed comics, including Batman: Dark Patterns, Batman Vol. 1–10 (2011–2016), and Absolute Batman Vol. 1: The Zoo. Bring your imagination and celebrate Batman Day on September 19th with the Dark Knight’s greatest adventures, and help support the BINC Foundation with your purchase!

Redeemed on GlobalComix. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate before October 10th, 2027. Titles are not available for download off of GlobalComix.

expires_today.title: POLY Game Dev Assets Collection #3
expires_today.long_description: Game developers, build your worlds easily and efficiently with our latest POLY Game Dev Asset Collection by Animpic Studio! Pay what you want for thousands of sharp assets from professional‑quality packs like POLY - Survival Subway, POLY - Survival Tower & Builder, and POLY - Fantasy House & Builder. These Unity and Unreal Engine‑compatible packs include FBX models, prefabs, materials, shaders, and multiple scene files. Create picture‑perfect polygon‑based assets without straining your team or wallet, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

expires_today.title: IGN 30th Anniversary Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
September is a big month for many reasons—and this September is even bigger, because we’re celebrating IGN’s 30th Anniversary! That’s right, it’s been 30 years since the very first post on IGN’s website, and to kick off the festivities we’re bringing all of you a gift: A bundle of IGN favorites to enjoy all month long, and beyond! Wage war against the dragons of Tamriel and master the art of necromancy in The Elder Scrolls Online - Elsweyr! Brave the dark reefs and deep oceans and try your best not to get eaten in Subnautica! Protect reality itself from an unknown evil in post-apocalyptic horror game REMNANT II! There’s even more fun to be had in this fantastic bundle of fan-favorite games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support Child’s Play with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 9th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete Claude and Anthropic Certification Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Start an exciting career in AI with a little help from us and the pros at Mammoth Club with The Complete Claude and Anthropic Certification Bundle. Enjoy massive savings on first‑time Humble‑exclusive software courses designed to help you ace your certification exams with compelling courses and challenging practice tests like Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P) with Practice Exam and GPT-6 Astra Fundamentals: From First Prompt to Practical Applications. Learn how to design safe and steerable AI systems without the hassle of writing your own code, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!
